description: Lists tasks in the platform CRM — work on a platform lead — about a prospective tenant, not about a tenant's customer. Cursor-paginated: limit 1-100, opaque cursor from the previous page. Filters: q, status, lead_id, assignee_user_id. Needs a human session with the platform_admin grant; tenant ownership does not qualify. Every item carries an absolute url.
